_doc: One row per (who is in the scene, camo). Shown immediately after Snake switches camo mid-conversation, then the conversation resumes. lines: [speaker id from characters.json or 'narr', expression (a mood column name from characters.json, a literal KS expression, or null), text]. 'none' is used when no one is on screen. Lilly is blind (reacts to sounds), Shizune is deaf (reacts to sight, Misha voices her signs).

lines: Oh, back to the boring green? You look like a P.E. teacher who lost a war.
Stripes! Ha! Are you a tiger now? Can tigers run a 400 metre, though?
Tigers don't need to run. They wait.
Wait, where did you— oh. You're just standing in front of the hedge. Wow.
Hey! Did you get changed while I was talking? That's rude AND fast.
Raindrops, huh. That's the pattern the border guards wear. ...Not that I'd know that.
You look like a marshmallow. A really scary marshmallow.
A TUXEDO? On a running track?!
Put a shirt on! There are children here! I'M children here!
Hanako hides behind her bangs and the nearest bookshelf at the same time.
I... I lost track of you for a second. You were... a plant.
I-is it raining... on you? Only on you?
You look like the corner of the library no one goes to. ...That's a compliment.
Is... is this a d-date? I didn't agree to a— I'm not ready for a—
It's not a date. It's a cover.
Hanako makes a sound like a kettle and leaves the room without moving her feet.
Heavy cotton twill. You've changed back into something sensible, I take it.
That was a zipper, three buttons and... a sleeve that smells of the jungle. Mr. Snake, are you changing clothes mid-sentence?
You rustle now. Like a hedge with opinions.
Hm. The fabric sounds different. German, I believe. Stiff.
Velcro again. I'm starting to think you have a costume problem.
I can't see what you're wearing, so you needn't keep doing that for my benefit.
Oh my. Silk lapels. Is that a cummerbund? How very civilised.
Why is the air suddenly... warmer? And why has Hanako fainted?
Mr. Snake. Are you not wearing a shirt?
You went back to the green that's the colour of tinned peas.
Oh. You're a tiger that's been folded wrong. I like it.
If I paint you now, will you come out as a tree or a man?
That one is a painting of an argument.
It's raining on your shirt but not on your face. Is that sad?
Now you're a blank canvas. Hold still.
Rin raises a brush with her foot. Snake decides not to hold still.
Are you going to a funeral or a wedding? They're the same clothes. That's always bothered me.
Your scars look like a map. Can I copy them? I won't use my hands.
Shicchan says, "Acceptable! That is almost a uniform!" Wahahaha~!
Shicchan says that is not school uniform~! She is writing it down!
Shicchan says, "Where did he go?" Hicchan, she can't find you, you're right there!
She says she likes a man who changes tactics in the middle of a negotiation~!
[[ That is Warsaw Pact pattern. Where did you get it? ]
Ehh? Shicchan, I'm not translating that, it sounds like a trap~!
[[ You look like a sheet of council paper. ]
She says you look like a form she wants to stamp~!
[[ Finally. Someone who dresses for the student council. ]
She says "WHAT" in capital letters, Hicchan! I've never seen her sign in capitals!
Thank you. Now, back to the periodic table.
Nakai. We do not wear tigers in my class.
Has anyone seen the new transfer student? He was here a moment ago, next to that... fern.
Interesting pattern. Like a crystal lattice. ...Sit down.
That is a border guard's uniform, Nakai. The border guards have their own school.
Lab coat? Good. Someone finally takes chemistry seriously.
There is no prom, Nakai. This is a Soviet institution.
Detention. And a shirt. In that order.
Snake slips back into his fatigues. They smell like the drop.
Tiger stripe. Good for jungles. This is a school corridor. Snake wears it anyway.
Leaf pattern. Snake becomes one with a potted plant.
Splitter. Angular, hard to read. Like the mission.
Raindrop. When in the East, dress like the East.
Snow camo. Snake briefly misses the drop zone.
A tuxedo. No one is around to see it. That's the saddest part.
Shirtless and alone in a Soviet school. Snake reconsiders his choices for exactly one second.
